    """Turn the less frequent color to 0 and recolor the dominant one with it."""
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)
    colors = list(counts)
    if len(colors) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected a two-color grid")
    dominant = max(colors, key=lambda color: counts[color])
    minority = next(color for color in colors if color != dominant)
    return [[minority if cell == dominant else 0 for cell in row] for row in grid]
"
